title: Java4Shell, NGINX2Shell and more: Why we are not at "Yellow", (Wed, Nov 18th)
content_md: About a month ago, we went to Infocon Yellow for the first time in a few years. We decided to address the php2shell vulnerability and alert our readers to its significant impact. Following php2shell, we had a number of vulnerabilities and events that may also have scored high enough to trigger an Infocon “Yellow” [infocon]. In the last few days, we had a major Microsoft 365 outage, a critical vulnerability in Java, and a critical vulnerability in NGINX, which was disclosed today. Article Link: Java4Shell, NGINX2Shell and more: Why we are not at "Yellow"
exclude_reason: SANS ISC meta-diary explaining why several known vulnerabilities did not trigger Infocon Yellow; commentary on stories already covered, not a new security event.
